name: player_name
description: Player name with accents as published by FIFA, e.g. 'Kylian Mbappé', 'Warren Zaïre-Emery'. Display this.

name: player_search_name
description: Player name in lower-case ASCII without accents or punctuation, e.g. 'kylian mbappe', 'warren zaire emery'. Filter on this with LIKE.

name: team
description: National team (English name), e.g. 'France', 'United States', 'Ivory Coast', 'South Korea'.

name: fifa_code
description: 3-letter FIFA code of the national team, e.g. FRA, ARG.

name: confederation
description: Confederation of the national team: UEFA, CONMEBOL, CONCACAF, CAF, AFC, OFC.

name: team_stage_reached
description: How far the player's national team went: Champion, Runner-up, Third place, Fourth place, Quarter-final, Round of 16, Round of 32, Group stage.

name: jersey_number
description: Shirt number in the national team.

name: position
description: Position code: GK (goalkeeper), DF (defender), MF (midfielder), FW (forward).

name: position_label
description: Position in words: Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder, Forward.

name: club
description: Club at the time of the tournament, e.g. 'Paris Saint-Germain', 'Real Madrid C. F.', 'FC Bayern München'.

name: club_country
description: 3-letter code of the club's country (league), e.g. FRA for Ligue 1 clubs, ENG, ESP, GER, ITA.

name: date_of_birth
description: Date of birth.

name: age_at_tournament
description: Age in years on 2026-06-11 (opening match).

name: matches_played
description: Number of matches the player appeared in (started or came on).

name: matches_started
description: Number of matches started.

name: minutes_played
description: Total minutes played (stoppage time not counted).

name: goals
description: Goals scored, own goals excluded, penalties included (shoot-outs excluded).

name: assists
description: Assists as counted by FBref. NULL only if the assists source was not loaded.

name: penalty_goals
description: Goals scored from a penalty during play (shoot-outs excluded).

name: own_goals
description: Own goals conceded by this player.

name: yellow_cards
description: Yellow cards received (a second yellow counts as a red card, not as a yellow).

name: red_cards
description: Red cards received (straight red or second yellow).

name: goals_per_90
description: Goals per 90 minutes played. NULL if the player never played.

name: minutes_per_goal
description: Minutes played per goal. NULL if no goal.
